title: vgrav: Radial–vertical gravity decoupling in the Milky Way
description: Reproducibility package for 'Radial–vertical gravity decoupling in the Milky Way: modified gravity and dark matter tests using Gaia DR3' (R. Monjo and A. E. Sasi, 2026, in preparation). Cold dark matter haloes (NFW, Einasto), QUMOND, STVG, the apparent dark matter of Verlinde's emergent gravity, f(R) gravity, refracted gravity and hyperconical modified gravity (HMG) are fitted to 152 model-independent Milky Way rotation-curve points and the 44 vertical-potential measurements of Wang et al. (2026), with the full likelihood of that work, four ensembles of 100 Monte Carlo baryonic realisations and the Bayesian information criterion. QUMOND, STVG and refracted gravity are solved with their field equations. Includes the vgrav Python library, the fitted outputs, the scripts that rebuild the tables and figures of the paper, and the full pipeline.
